title: The kb says Remote Control server mode runs several sessions from one process, not only one remote session per interactive process
goal: SP-4dab3cy5 review G1 (S2, ST-5mcrotet): kb/public/claude/cross-session-messaging.md's DER fact says Remote Control forwards the prompts of one session at a time, but the Remote Control page (https://code.claude.com/docs/en/remote-control) says that limit is per interactive process and that `claude remote-control` server mode runs concurrent sessions from one process (`--capacity <N>`, `--spawn worktree`). The article states the one-session limit as the interactive-process case and records server mode's concurrent sessions with their flags, tagged and cited.

run:
import sys
t=open('kb/public/claude/cross-session-messaging.md').read()
ok='--capacity' in t and 'server mode' in t.lower()
print('server mode and --capacity in the article:',ok);sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)
